name: FMS Fleet 2-Day Rolling Backup & OneDrive Retention Sync

parameters.command: powershell.exe -Command "$date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'; $dest = 'C:\FMS_Backups'; if (!(Test-Path $dest)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force }; Write-Host 'Triggering local FMS shadow backup...'; fmsadmin backup -y -d ('filewin:/' + $dest.Replace('\', '/')); Write-Host 'Zipping backup...'; Compress-Archive -Path ('C:\Program Files\FileMaker\FileMaker Server\Data\Backups\*') -DestinationPath ('C:\FMS_Backups\' + $date + '.zip') -Force; Write-Host 'Enforcing 2-Day local retention...'; Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\FMS_Backups\*.zip' | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-2) } | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host 'Backup Complete'"
